statement: Project OI provides a coherent, literature-grounded working synthesis of Organisational Intelligence.
qualification_or_reason: This is a synthesis claim, not empirical validation.

statement: Project OI defines Organisational Intelligence as a persistent organisation-level capacity to orient, coordinate and improve future response through feedback.
qualification_or_reason: Use the exact short or extended definition from OI-BOK-010 v0.3.

statement: Orient, Coordinate and Improve are the retained higher-order transformations in the current working model.
qualification_or_reason: Their empirical necessity and discriminant validity remain open.

statement: Sense, Know, Choose, Mobilise, Learn and Adapt form the Project OI operational capability model.
qualification_or_reason: They are design and research categories, not validated latent factors or mandatory workflow steps.

statement: Contextualise is a recurring connective mechanism, Organisational Orientation is an integrated state and Outcome–Feedback is the bridge from Mobilise to Learn.
qualification_or_reason: These objects remain subject to empirical boundary testing.

statement: Connection Quality is a provisional integrative research hypothesis and diagnostic lens concerning transition integrity.
qualification_or_reason: It is not a validated constitutive dimension or score.

statement: The BOK distinguishes descriptive OI capability from the responsible exercise of that capability.
qualification_or_reason: Consequential use should normally report both capability and responsible-exercise evidence.

statement: The BOK supplies a traceable proposition, diagnostic, evidence and open-question architecture.
qualification_or_reason: The registers are research infrastructure, not validated instruments.

statement: AI is treated as one organisational participant or capability element whose authority, memory, tools, evidence and outcomes require governance.
qualification_or_reason: The construct applies whether or not an organisation uses AI.

statement: The first coherent BOK release contains ten substantive chapters and a controlled consolidation set.
qualification_or_reason: Completion means coherent release, not scientific closure.

statement: Project OI invented Organisational Intelligence.
qualification_or_reason: The explicit OI lineage predates Project OI.

statement: Project OI is the first human–machine or sociotechnical theory of Organisational Intelligence.
qualification_or_reason: Earlier explicit OI models include human–machine and sociotechnical elements.

statement: The BOK is an empirically validated general theory.
qualification_or_reason: Field, longitudinal, discriminant and predictive validation remain open.

statement: The six operational capabilities are mutually exclusive, statistically proven, necessary or sufficient in every episode.
qualification_or_reason: No factor structure or universal necessity has been established.

statement: Connection Quality is a validated construct or composite metric.
qualification_or_reason: It remains a Project OI working hypothesis.

statement: The BOK provides a validated maturity model, diagnostic survey or single OI score.
qualification_or_reason: No validated weights, thresholds or aggregation rules exist.

statement: Positive performance or favourable outcome proves high Organisational Intelligence.
qualification_or_reason: Capability, implementation, outcome and external conditions are distinct.

statement: The model has been validated for SMBs.
qualification_or_reason: SMB applicability remains a primary field-research hypothesis.

statement: The software product implements, proves or is canonically defined by the BOK.
qualification_or_reason: Product and architecture reconciliation begins only after this release and must preserve a research-to-product boundary.

statement: Current AI and AI-agent evidence is timeless or provider-independent.
qualification_or_reason: AI evidence is versioned, setting-specific and subject to lifecycle review.

statement: The organisation-level unit, multilevel emergence and persistence thresholds remain empirically under-tested.
qualification_or_reason: Use the claim-boundary protocol and bounded evidence.

statement: The feedback-coupled transition mechanism remains a plausible hypothesis rather than a proven causal sequence.
qualification_or_reason: Test through longitudinal episode tracing and counterexamples.

statement: The evidence portfolio and diagnostic architecture have not been psychometrically or operationally validated.
qualification_or_reason: Do not create high-stakes scores or rankings.

statement: Power, structural inequality, labour-process, stakeholder and rights-based perspectives are less developed than the information, knowledge and capability literatures.
qualification_or_reason: This is a priority conceptual and field-research stream.

statement: Authority, privacy, consent, voice and accountability vary across legal and cultural settings.
qualification_or_reason: Every consequential application requires local interpretation.

statement: The 290-source manifest count is provisional because compound citations and title-based deduplication remain imperfect.
qualification_or_reason: The occurrence crosswalk preserves the 338 exact chapter entries.

statement: Six defined footnotes remain uncited in Chapters 6, 8 and 9 as supporting reference residue.
qualification_or_reason: No cited footnote is missing a definition.

statement: Stable older references were structurally reconciled but not all independently reopened at publisher pages during CORR-002.
qualification_or_reason: Current and anomalous AI-era sources were verified within the recorded scope.

statement: AI evidence can expire through model, provider, interface, benchmark and standards change.
qualification_or_reason: Use the 18-record lifecycle register and reverify before each major release.

statement: The BOK was developed beside a product programme and may retain residual product-selection bias despite the deferred reconciliation boundary.
qualification_or_reason: Architecture reconciliation must treat the BOK as input, not foregone product justification.
